## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution. Keep the change focused.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation or community infrastructure
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed and their results.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] I did not commit secrets, credentials, or private farm/device data.
- [ ] I considered tenant isolation and authorization where applicable.
- [ ] I documented database migrations, environment changes, and compatibility impact, or none are required.
- [ ] Device-control behavior remains safe by default (`ENABLE_AUTO_EXECUTION=false`) or the change includes an explicit safety review.
- [ ] MQTT topic or payload changes are documented and backward-compatible, or no MQTT contract changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is up to date and the diff contains only intended files.
- [ ] Relevant tests and type checks pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] Breaking changes and known limitations are clearly described.
